evidence_items.source_title: What Betfair Exchange market data is available from listMarketBook / Stream API? - Betfair Developer Program

evidence_items.notes: Provider identity (Betfair) equals the single operator identity; multi-operator Consensus/SpotBoard requires several distinct operators (DEC-013).

evidence_items.source_title: What data/request limits exist on the Exchange API? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: Exchange API data requests are weighted: sum(Weight) x number of market ids must not exceed 200 points per request (a weighted per-request data constraint; exceeding it returns TOO_MUCH_DATA).
evidence_items.excerpt: sum (Weight) * number of market ids must not exceed 200 points per requests
evidence_items.notes: A weighted per-request data limit, not a requests-per-second rate.

evidence_items.source_title: What data is provided by the Historical Data service? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: The Betfair Historical Data service provides detailed historical Exchange market, price and settlement data from April 2015 (a separate paid Historical Data service).
evidence_items.excerpt: detailed historical market data for the Betfair Exchange, including market, price and settlement information ... from April 2015.
evidence_items.notes: Technical availability via a separate paid service; retention/use rights are a separate question and remain UNKNOWN (DEC-024).

evidence_items.source_title: Which jurisdictions is Betfair Exchange Historical Data available to? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: The Historical Data service is available to Betfair.com customers only; Betfair.br/.it/.es/.ro/.se customers cannot access historicdata.betfair.com.
evidence_items.notes: Scoped to the Historical Data service; not a general restriction on every Betfair API capability.

evidence_items.source_title: Which API Licence Do I Require? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: Commercial use is governed by distinct API licence categories: personal use; Software Vendor Licence; Betting Operator/Company Data Licence; and Odds Publisher Licence (for affiliates). Commercial routes require applying to / contacting Betfair Developer Support.
evidence_items.notes: A required licence does not itself grant a data-use right; rights remain UNKNOWN until the specific governing licence establishes them.

evidence_items.source_title: What Betfair Exchange market data is available from listMarketBook / Stream API? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: The accessible support pages document market-data content and identifiers but not selection identifiers or source-observed timestamp semantics; deeper API reference pages were not retrievable this sprint.
evidence_items.notes: Rights recorded UNKNOWN and fail closed.
